newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Smelting says deposits found.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Smelting says deposits found.

text.p: Malaysia Smelting Corp Bhd said a preliminary draft feasibility report had confirmed the existence of polymetallic deposits at the Mount Pleasant mine in Canada.
The mine is owned by Adex Mining Corp, with which Malaysia Smelting signed an investment agreement in April 1996.

Malaysia Smelting said in a statement that Adex was currently reviewing various recommendations made by independent mining consultant, Kvaerner Metals Davy Ltd, to further assess the bankability of the proposed mine development, including evaluation of toll smelting versus on-site indium production.
The final Kvaerner Metals report was expected to be delivered by mid-April, it said.

Under the investment agreement, Malaysia Smelting was to subscribe for 8.7 million shares in Adex, of which 3.7 million ringgit from the proceeds would be used to fund the Mount Pleasant feasibility study.

On completion and acceptance of the study, Malaysia Smelting had the option to further subscribe up to 113.04 million shares amounting to 48 million ringgit which would give it 51 percent control of Adex.
